title: Minimum Rounds to Complete All Tasks
goal: Finish tasks in the fewest rounds of two or three equal-difficulty tasks.
strategy: Each difficulty is independent. A single occurrence is impossible; every count at least two is representable by twos and threes, with minimum rounds equal to the count divided by three rounded up.
